exclusions.source_text: ECOG performance status of 0-1 (see APPENDIX A).
Total bilirubin ≤ 1.5 × institutional upper limit of normal (ULN)

exclusions.threshold: AST/ALT <= 2.5 x ULN (<= 5 x ULN with liver metastases)
creatinine <= 1.5 x ULN or CrCl >= 60 mL/min

exclusions.source_text: The effects of abemaciclib on the developing human fetus are unknown. For this reason women of child-bearing potential and men must agree to use adequate contraception
Pregnant women are excluded from this study because abemaciclib is an agent with the potential for teratogenic or abortifacient effects.
breastfeeding should be discontinued if the mother is treated with abemaciclib.
Participants with known HIV-positive status are ineligible because these participants are at increased risk of lethal infections when treated with marrow-suppressive therapy.
Participants with symptomatic CNS metastases who are neurologically unstable and/or require radiation therapy are excluded.
symptomatic congestive heart failure, unstable angina pectoris, cardiac arrhythmia
